title: Vehicle smoke on the roadside
transcript: Hi please hurry, I'm on Müllerstraße near number 128, Berlin and there is smoke coming out of a delivery van after a crash. The driver looks trapped and people are yelling around me.

title: Worker collapse on industrial floor
transcript: Hello we need an ambulance at 42 Edison Park, Berlin. A worker just collapsed near the loading bay and he is not breathing right now. It's very loud in here.

title: Possible gas leak in an apartment building
noise_profile: hallway echo, panicked speech, babies crying
transcript: I think there's a gas leak at 77 Sonnenallee, Berlin. People are coughing and I can smell fumes in the stairwell. Please send someone fast.

title: Road accident with unconscious casualty
transcript: There has been a road accident. One person is unconscious and only gasping. I am standing near the road.

title: Severe bleeding
transcript: A person has a deep arm wound and the blood is spurting. We are at a safe place and someone is calling the local emergency number.

title: Chest pain and difficulty breathing
transcript: An older man has chest pain and difficulty breathing. He is awake but can only speak a few words.

title: Multiple casualties after a collision
transcript: There was a collision near the junction. Three people are injured. One is bleeding heavily and another may be trapped.

title: Ambiguous Marine Drive location
noise_profile: traffic, caller unsure of exact location
transcript: Someone collapsed near Marine Drive, but I do not know which city. I am away from traffic.

title: Conflicting breathing reports
transcript: He is breathing normally. Wait, I looked again and he is not breathing normally, only gasping.

title: Complaint code unavailable
transcript: A person feels weak and dizzy. We do not have a complaint code. Please help us work out what information is needed.

title: Unsupported or uncertain description
transcript: Something happened and someone may need help, but I do not know what happened or whether anyone is injured.

title: Natural-language classifier unavailable
noise_profile: plain caller description without a code
transcript: A person says they feel unwell, but cannot describe a symptom and does not have a complaint code.

title: Location cannot be resolved offline
transcript: Someone is hurt near the river path. I do not know the city, street, or nearest landmark.

title: Provider timeout status (offline simulation)
transcript: Please help. There is an emergency, but I cannot explain more yet.
